explanation: Compared against erdosproblems.com/733 and [Er81]: once the upper bound is known, Erdős asked whether lim log f(n)/n^{1/2} exists, where f(n) counts all-lines sequences. The statement uses allLinesSequences, in which L is exactly the set of lines with ≥ 2 points, as in [Er81], and asserts the limit exists in ℝ. Faithful.
